utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Firstly, can everyone hear clearly? Can you all get the interpretation?. Can you hear me? Yes? Everyone is hearing me? The Registrar, can you hear me? My colleagues? Registrar, can you say the case of today?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: IT-96-20-PT, Prosecutor against General Djukic. Who is representing the Office of the Prosecutor, Mr. Blewitt?

utterances.speaker: MR. BLEWITT
utterances.text: If I please the court, I appear with my colleagues, Mr. Blaxill and Mr. Keegan.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: The Trial Chamber made up of Judge Jorda, Judge 0dio Benito and Judge Riad assisted by Mr. Marro, a joint Registrar on 24th April 1996 will give the following decision relating to the keeping of the indictment -- everyone can hear me, yes -- and on the provisional release.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: This was done in French and English; the French version is the authentic one done on 24th April 1996. The session is closed.
